title: The quiz
summary: One question, two answers: your app tells whether you are right.
done: Your quiz works! Add more questions on new screens, and let your friends play.

welcome.text: Today, let’s build a **quiz**: a question, two answer buttons, and your app tells whether you are right.

question.text: Put a **Text** on the screen and write your question in its **text** box, for example “How many legs does a spider have?”.

two-buttons.text: Add **two buttons**: one for each answer.

answers.text: Write an answer on each button, for example “8” on {{Button}} (the right one) and “6” on {{Button.2}}.
answers.hint: Click a button on the screen to select it, then change its text.

go-blocks.text: Everything is in place. Open the **Blocks** tab.

first-event.text: In **{{Button}}**, take [when {{Button}} is clicked] and drop it in the middle.

right.text: In **Interface**, take [show the message] and snap it inside “when {{Button}} is clicked”. Type “Well done!” in its box.

second-event.text: Your turn for the wrong answer: in **{{Button.2}}**, take [when {{Button.2}} is clicked].

wrong.text: Put a message in it too, for example “Try again!”.

play.text: Play your quiz in the preview: try both answers!
